New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe to our podcast and follow it on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player to get new episodes first.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • Report says Apple is developing a new Vision Pro and considering different form factor designs
  • Latest leak reveals details about the new iPad mini
  • Leaked images reveal new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini
  • Apple ordered to pay $5.7 billion in damages for Taptic Engine patent infringement
